rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=48, pretrain_lr=0.0001, itnet_k=3, itnet_alpha=0.005, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-2 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol) for itnet = ItNet v1 (pretrain-denoiser-then-DC, solver_itnet.py). SIX-BOX. (1) PRIOR RESULT: iter-1 SSIM 0.4413 / hr 0.000, elapsed_s=191 of the HARD 1200s (20-min) budget -> ~1009s UNUSED. NOT budget-limited. (2) FAILURE MODE: the pretrain-denoiser-then-DC path UNDER-CONVERGES -- v1 0.441 sits far below the sibling itnet_v3 END-TO-END recipe (0.896, hr 0.268) at the same ep8/k=3/c=16 seed. v1 only trained the SmallUNet denoiser for 8 epochs (200 steps/epoch = 1600 UNet steps) then ran a pure-inference k=3 DC unroll; finetune_itnet() is NOT called so pretrain_epochs is the ONLY training lever. (3) ONE KNOB: pretrain_epochs 8 -> 48 (6x). Justification by the unused-budget NUMBERS: 8 epochs cost ~191s total wall (incl. the ~one-time 214-slice per-sample val pass + figure); scaling pretrain 6x should land ~700-900s, comfortably inside 1200s given ~1009s headroom. grad_clip=1.0 and val_n=214 UNCHANGED. (4) HYPOTHESIS: more pretraining lifts v1 toward the v3 band (hr>0, SSIM climbing toward ~0.9) because a better-converged FBP denoiser feeds the DC unroll a cleaner init. FALSIFIER: if val stays flat ~0.44, the pretrain-then-DC ARCHITECTURE is structurally capped (not epochs-limited) -> note for iter-3 that v1 must move to END-TO-END training like v3 (call finetune_itnet / unroll the denoiser through the DC steps). (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min, val_n=214 (NOT reduced), grad_clip=1.0. (6) No control return. HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (val chunk=1, itnet.projector swap per slice), bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override).
